name: RebornHack
description: Pause-menu hack panel: noclip, jump hack, autoclicker, speedhack, FPS, hitboxes, unlock icons, info overlay and a macro recorder/replayer with 3 slots per level. Safe mode is always on: a run that used cheats or a macro can never be saved as a real completion.

dark-theme.name: Dark theme
dark-theme.description: Use the dark style for the hack panel.
